newsitem.title: GERMANY: German consumer prices static in April.
newsitem.headline: German consumer prices static in April.

text.p: Germany's consumer price index stood unchanged in April compared to the previous month and registered a gain of just 1.4 percent year-on-year, the Federal Statistics Office said on Tuesday.
Underlining the continued low inflation outlook for Germany, the statistics office said the consumer price index for the country as a whole stood at 117.9 in April, the same level as for March.
For west Germany, price pressures were even less in evidence, with April consumer prices falling 0.2 percent in April compared with March and rising 1.3 percent year-on-year.
East German prices continued to rise in April, up 0.2 percent month-on-month and 1.5 percent year-on-year.

The statistics office highlighted strong increases in prices for fresh fruit and coffee, together with higher rail travel prices introduced by the Deutsche Bahn railways at the beginning of the month, as major factors within the figures.
